name: KIC 1160986
description: A red giant climbing its first giant branch in the Kepler field, 18.6 solar radii and 0.92 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 1160986 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 18.6311 +/- 0.3721

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 1160986 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 0.9228 +/- 0.0402

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 1160986 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4316.977 +/- 42.5267

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the colour routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant in the Kepler field, 19 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 0.92 solar masses and 18.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,317 K at its surface.
